name: Gauge & Pin Co. (Fictional)
summary: Turned pins, stamped brackets, and welded frames from Ningbo, for buyers who send a drawing.

contact.address: 88 Fixture Lane, Beilun, Ningbo, Zhejiang, China

products.name: Hardened dowel pin
products.summary: 100Cr6 dowel, hardened 58-62 HRC. Kept on the catalog shelf.
products.body: Ground after heat treat. Diameter holds ±0.01 mm, h6, unless the drawing asks tighter. Catalog MOQ is 500 pieces. Repeat lots ship 18 days after the deposit. Sample lot is 50 pieces.
products.imageAlt: Hardened steel dowel pin on a gray sweep

products.name: 304 shoulder bolt
products.summary: 304 shoulder bolt. The shoulder is ground to the drawing.
products.body: Shoulder holds ±0.02 mm. Catalog MOQ is 500 pieces. Repeat lots ship 18 days after the deposit.
products.imageAlt: Stainless shoulder bolt on a gray sweep

products.name: SPCC hinge bracket
products.summary: SPCC hinge bracket. Hole sizes are on the drawing.
products.body: Stock is 2.0 mm SPCC. Critical holes hold ±0.05 mm. Custom stampings start at 1,000 pieces. First article is 25 days. Repeat production is 35 days after sample sign-off.
products.imageAlt: Stamped steel hinge bracket on a gray sweep

products.name: Q235 rack upright
products.summary: Q235 rack upright. Quoted from the weld drawing.
products.body: Hole position holds ±0.5 mm after the jig is checked. Price is quoted from the drawing. Repeat production is 35 days after sample sign-off.
products.imageAlt: Welded rack upright on a gray sweep

products.name: 6061-T6 aluminum standoff
products.body: Turned diameter holds ±0.02 mm. Catalog MOQ is 500 pieces. Repeat lots ship 18 days after the deposit.
products.imageAlt: Aluminum standoff on a gray sweep

products.name: 304 cabinet kit
products.summary: 304 cabinet kit. Screws, nuts, and washers in one bag.
products.body: One kit is the bag a cabinet line calls for. MOQ is 500 sets. Repeat lots ship 18 days after the deposit.
products.imageAlt: Bag of stainless screws nuts and washers

uses.name: Cabinet hardware
uses.summary: Hinges, pins, and kits for sheet-metal cabinets.
uses.body: The cabinet line takes the hinge bracket, the dowel, and the bagged kit. Stampings come from Cixi. Machining and the kit pack happen in Beilun.

uses.name: Farm implements
uses.summary: Brackets and pins for implements that see mud and washdown.
uses.body: Brackets are stamped SPCC. Pins are turned 304 or C45. The buyer marks which faces see washdown.
uses.imageAlt: Steel bracket on a farm implement

uses.name: Warehouse racking
uses.summary: Uprights and connectors for pallet rack frames.
uses.body: Uprights are welded Q235. Hole position is held to ±0.5 mm. The drawing sets the beam pitch.
uses.imageAlt: Welded rack upright on a pallet frame

uses.name: Appliance OEM
uses.summary: Standoffs and brackets for appliance chassis.
uses.body: Standoffs are 6061-T6. Brackets are SPCC. Both ship in the buyer's carton mark.
uses.imageAlt: Aluminum standoff on an appliance chassis

news.name: 250 t press in Cixi
news.summary: Mar 2026. The 250 t press replaced an older 160 t line. The press count is still 18.
news.body: Cixi still runs 18 presses. The new 250 t press took the place of a 160 t line. It did not add a nineteenth press. Stampings that also need machining still go to Beilun.
news.imageAlt: A large stamping press in a shop

news.name: Sample window stays 25 days
news.summary: Jan 2026. First article stays at 25 days. Custom repeats stay at 35 days after sign-off. Catalog repeats stay at 18 days.
news.body: The sample window did not move. First article is still 25 days. After the buyer signs the sample, repeat production is 35 days. Catalog repeats stay at 18 days after the deposit.
news.imageAlt: A small sample lot of turned pins

news.name: Ningbo to Hamburg lane
news.summary: Nov 2025. Ningbo to Hamburg is a regular lane. Germany was already among the 16 countries.
news.body: The Hamburg sailing is a lane, not a new country. The 2025 export list stays at 16 countries. Germany has been on it since the first shipment in 2018.
news.imageAlt: Plywood crates staged for a vessel

news.name: 2025 gauge calibration
news.summary: Aug 2025. Calibration log for the year is closed. The CMM is the same one in the Beilun gauge room.
news.body: The log is closed for 2025. The gauge room did not move. It has sat beside the CNC aisle since 2024. The room still has one CMM.
news.imageAlt: A CMM beside a row of machines
